summary: ANT/USDG pool live on Robinhood Chain mainnet through the v3 (halt-aware) factory. The price report rides in the swap; no publisher runs.

haltStack.note: Deployed on the owner's go-ahead without an independent review (the owner's decision: own review and the tests only). No halt has been recorded on mainnet; the REPORTER leaves for the halt registry are not delegated.

pool.creator: 0xf3784048450e72596cd18bF079aED441894176e4
pool.caps: 0.24 USDG per trade, 0.96 USDG per window (half of NVDA's, first 30 days)
pool.withdrawal: the position NFT is held by the creator wallet; the hook has no remove-liquidity callback (mask 0x2cc0), exits were proven on the NVDA mainnet pool in evidence/einstein/exits.json

token.onChainName: Anthropic, PBC Class A Common Stock • Robinhood Token
token.logo: apps/web/public/assets/tokens/ant.png: Anthropic's own mark from anthropic.com. Brief 3 says not to use Anthropic's logo; the owner decided on 24 Nov 2026 to use it to identify the token, and the compliance text on the page says so. Robinhood's own token image is blocked (403).

priceSource.method: swap-carried report: GET /ant-update on the keeper-b Worker signs the direct sample and one session report with the ANT delegate key from Robinhood's pricing API; the swap page puts it in oracleUpdates

stoppedPublisher.why: 423,129 gas per report at 0.02 gwei is about 0.0000085 ETH, one every 45 seconds is about 0.0007 ETH an hour; stopped after about two hours

intervalKeeping.where: the keeper-b Worker cron (workers/keeper-b/src/ant-calendar.mjs), not the owner's computer
intervalKeeping.proof: on an anvil fork of mainnet with time advanced 7 hours the Worker module activated the PRE interval (phase 1) by itself and the second run saw it current; first live boundary after deploy is 09:00 UTC on 24 Nov 2026
intervalKeeping.wallet: the Worker's BELL_TRANSACTION_PRIVATE_KEY wallet 0x14B71d1BA5dE1e718B1f1e05c8ec0333FE1d0079, about 0.000266 ETH at the time of writing
intervalKeeping.calendarEnds: 1 Jan 2027 (root 0xe0d59218fdeb5f4ab2b10064e454a4490d54a90b58f52d514d7977f0ebc3c33d, 114 leaves); a new root is needed before then
intervalKeeping.firstLiveBoundary: 09:00 UTC on 24 Nov 2026 (not yet observed when this was written)

stillNeedsTheOwnersComputer: nothing. The Worker signs price reports per swap and keeps the calendar interval active from its cron; the delegate renewal runs as the GitHub workflow .github/workflows/ant-delegate-renew.yml every 4 hours and renews only when under 6 hours remain.
notDone: no swap from the web page itself was clicked through (the same path was proven by script and the page type-checks)
Sourcify exact match for the v3 contracts, explorer verification
the ANT pool's auction was not exercised
a new calendar root before 1 Jan 2027
A5 for REGULAR, PRE, POST and CLOSED as the sessions occur (the first CLOSED is Thanksgiving)
a new calendar root before 1 Jan 2027 needs GOVERNANCE signing, whose signer state is still on the owner's computer
earnings dates for event windows: nobody maintains them yet

delegateRenewal.where: GitHub Actions workflow ant-delegate-renew (belldex/bell), cron 17 */4 * * *, concurrency group so runs never overlap
delegateRenewal.signerState: REPORTER SHRINCS state is encrypted and kept on the pq-state branch (ciphertext only); the AES key, the REPORTER ECDSA key, the delegate key, the sender key and the RPC URL are repository secrets. The local copy was retired (contracts/pq/keys/robinhood-4663/reporter.enc.migrated-to-ci) so no leaf is used from two places; the local scheduled task bell-ant-delegate-renew is disabled.

firstCiRun.result: delegation read back as 25.0 hours remaining on all four adapters

delegateRenewal.whyNotTheWorker: a SHRINCS signature takes about 4 seconds of CPU (import 1.4 s, sign 2.8 s) and the Cloudflare account is on the Free plan (10 ms CPU, deploy with a CPU limit was refused: code 100328)
delegateRenewal.cost: about 320,000 gas per adapter, roughly 0.000026 ETH a day, paid by the Worker wallet 0x14B71d1BA5dE1e718B1f1e05c8ec0333FE1d0079
delegateRenewal.risk: the REPORTER keys now live in GitHub secrets; anyone who can push to belldex/bell or read its secrets could authorize a delegate and so sign ANT prices. Keep repository access tight.

haltProofsMainnet.note: Real halts recorded on the live ANT pool on 24 Nov 2026, not market halts (the Robinhood halt flag was not set). Each cost the pool minutes at the CLOSED fee. REPORTER actions are hybrid-signed by the ant-halt-action workflow from the signer state on the pq-state branch.
haltProofsMainnet.V6: 0xd685585a76af05aa09847a836a97f9d95c32ea1b94b330b45b1a14e16f0341eb (1 percent of the position removed during the halt, no hook log)

V4.status: pending the lapse; a one-shot check is scheduled in the session for 13:24 local on 24 Nov

haltProofsMainnet.V5: not done: needs an EVENT window in the ANT calendar (a new root signed through GOVERNANCE) and a swap inside it
haltProofsMainnet.V7: all v3 contracts and the hook are Sourcify match, not exact; the owner chose to leave them as match

ankerKeeper: The Worker cron (workers/keeper-b/src/ant-keeper.mjs) also keeps the pool through halts and closures: refreshState, a price report while RECOVERING, armResume, settle, and the closing anchor (report then captureClose) in the last five minutes before a planned closure. First planned closure: Thanksgiving, CLOSED from 2026-11-26T01:00:00Z. The recovery path was found when the first resume left the pool RECOVERING with a LOCKED auction: a swap cannot carry the report because a swap that reverts undoes it.
